identificationModule.officialTitle: Single Arm,Two Phase,Multicenter Trial to Evaluating the Efficacy and Safety of the CAR-T for Liver Cancer

descriptionModule.detailedDescription: This is a single-arm,multicenter Phase 2 study to evaluate the efficacy and safety of the CAR-T for Liver Cancer.The study will be conducted using a phaseⅠ /Ⅱ disign.The study will have the following sequential phases:Part A(screening leukapheresis,cell product preparation,and cytoreductive chemotherapy) and Part B(treatment and follow-up).The follow-up period for each paticipant is approximately 35 months after the final CAR-T infusion.The total duration of the study is expected to be approximately 3 years.A total of 25 patients may be enrolled over a period of 3 years.

primaryOutcomes.description: Tumor complete remission number + partial response number + number of stable disease /Total number of cases being treated
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: CAR - T back to lose 0 days to 180 days
